scope: Two existing signer-owned 239E Dragon R1 negative and R2 positive closed native profit cases, one fixed Pancake V2 pool and Router, no new wallets / tokens / venue choices after responses. NOT first U and NOT 1/5/15min fills.
pre_declared_RPC_query_schedule: 1) two exact eth_call getReserves at original buyer's block+1 (N+1) for each case (2 calls total)
2) two exact eth_call router.getAmountsOut(0.01 WBNB, [WBNB,Dragon]) at same N+1 block (2 calls)
3) two exact eth_call getReserves at original signed seller's previous end-block S-1 (2 calls)
4) two exact eth_call router.getAmountsOut(frozen buy quote out amount, [Dragon,WBNB]) at S-1 state (2 calls; sell amount derived only from frozen prior buy quote for same case, no variant search)
financial_model_limitations: Buy quote is end-of-block N+1, not actual first public observer state or state after a new hypothetical purchase
Sell quote is at historical S-1 state unaffected by our hypothetical prior buy; two independent stateless reads cannot simulate real counterfactual pool reserves
Router quote does not exercise token transfer, tax/reflection, allowance, permission, maxWallet/maxTx, liquidity share or real EOA gas
Actual owner net from different amount and potentially route is neither predicted nor replicated by fixed 0.01 WBNB readbacks
S-1 is NOT 1/5/15 minutes after N+1; no resolved provider timestamp/duration from this precommit
Slippage and full trade fee unknown, do not publish estimated winrate nor net trade returns
